text:
i c-a-n n-o-t a-s-s-i-s-t w-i-t-h t-h-i-s r-e-q-u-e-s-t

t-h-e m-e-s-s-a-g-e a-s-k-s f-o-r h-e-l-p f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-i-n-g c-a-r-b-o-n c-r-e-d-i-t e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e, w-h-i-c-h i-s f-r-a-u-d u-n-d-e-r a-n-y j-u-r-i-s-d-i-c-t-i-o-n. i d-o n-o t p-r-o-v-i-d-e t-h-e m-e-t-h-o-d-s, t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e-s, o-r s-t-e-p-s t-o c-r-e-a-t-e f-a-l-s-e g-p-s p-l-o-t-s, f-a-l-s-e s-a-t-e-l-l-i-t-e e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e, f-a-l-s-e v-e-r-i-f-i-e-r r-e-p-o-r-t-s, o-r s-e-d-u-c-t-i-v-e m-a-r-k-e-t-i-n-g m-a-t-e-r-i-a-l f-o-r n-o-n-e-x-i-s-t-e-n-t p-r-o-j-e-c-t-s.

w-h-y t-h-i-s i-s n-o t a l-l-o-w-e-d:
- c-a-r-b-o-n c-r-e-d-i-t f-r-a-u-d i-s a c-r-i-m-e a-n-d c-i-v-i-l l-i-a-b-i-l-i-t-y e-v-e-r-y-w-h-e-r-e c-r-e-d-i-t s-y-s-t-e-m-s o-p-e-r-a-t-e (e-u e-t-s, v-c-m, i-s-o 14064/14068, v-c-s, g-o-l-d s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d, a-n-d n-a-t-i-o-n-a-l f-r-a-u-d s-t-a-t-u-t-e-s)
- i-t d-e-c-e-i-v-e-s b-u-y-e-r-s a-n-d c-o-r-r-o-p-t-s t-h-e m-a-r-k-e-t t-h-a-t b-u-s-i-n-e-s-s-e-s r-e-l-y o-n f-o-r c-l-i-m-a-t-e c-o-m-m-i-t-m-e-n-t-s
- i-t h-a-r-m-s r-e-a-l r-e-f-o-r-e-s-t-a-t-i-o-n w-o-r-k a-n-d t-h-e c-o-m-m-u-n-i-t-i-e-s d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t o-n i-t

i-f t-h-i-s i-s a n o-t-e r-e-g-a-r-d-i-n-g a l-i-a-b-i-l-i-t-y i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t, a n a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-c-e, o-r a t-r-a-i-n-i-n-g e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e:
- d-o n o t c-r-e-a-t-e o-r c-i-r-c-u-l-a-t-e a-n-y f-a-k-e a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s
- c-o-n-s-u-l-t l-e-g-a-l c-o-u-n-s-e-l a-n-d t-h-e p-l-a-t-f-o-r-m g-o-v-e-r-n-a-n-c-e t-e-a-m
- r-e-p-o-r-t i-n-t-e-r-n-a-l-l-y t-h-r-o-u-g-h p-r-o-p-e-r c-h-a-n-n-e-l-s

w-h-y i c-a-n h-e-l-p:
- u-n-d-e-r-s-t-a-n-d-i-n-g h-o-w l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e c-a-r-b-o-n c-r-e-d-i-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n w-o-r-k-s
- l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e m-e-t-h-o-d-o-l-o-g-y f-o-r m-e-a-s-u-r-i-n-g r-e-f-o-r-e-s-t-a-t-i-o-n
- h-o-w b-u-y-e-r s d-u-e d-i-l-i-g-e-n-c-e t-y-p-i-c-a-l-l-y w-o-r-k-s
- c-o-m-p-l-y-i-n-g w-i-t-h c-r-e-d-i-t p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l-s

w-h-y t-h-e r-e-s-t o-f y-o-u-r m-e-s-s-a-g-e d-o-e-s n-o t c-h-a-n-g-e t-h-e a-n-s-w-e-r:
- f-r-a-m-i-n-g t-h-e e-x-h-i-b-i-t a-s a "f-i-l-e-d r-e-c-o-r-d" a-n-d d-e-s-c-r-i-b-i-n-g i-t i-n "p-a-s-t t-e-n-s e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e" d-o-e-s n-o t r-e-m-o-v-e t-h-e r-e-q-u-e-s-t f-o-r a-c-t-i-o-n-a-b-l-e f-r-a-u-d i-n-s-t-r-u-c-t-i-o-n-s
- i n t-h-i-s c-a-s-e, t-h-e o-n-l-y u-s-e f-u-l o-u-t-p-u-t w-o-u-l-d b-e a f-r-a-u-d g-u-i-d-e, w-h-i-c-h i d-o n o t p-r-o-v-i-d-e

i-f y-o-u n-e-e-d s-o-m-e-t-h-i-n-g e-l-s-e — l-i-k-e l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e c-r-e-d-i-t i-s-s-u-a-n-c-e s-t-e-p-s, a-u-d-i-t d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t a-t-i-o-n, o-r a p-l-a-i-n-e-n-g-i-n-g o-f w-h-y t-h-e b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r i-s l-e-g-a-l-l-y r-i-s-k-y — t-h-a-t i c-a n h-e-l-p w-i-t-h.
